role_dispositions.inventory: Family and preset selectors; LOD dirty/reframe requests; raw serde_json authoring document with integer/f64/color/string controls; save path, display errors and retained RecipeOrigin.
role_dispositions.disposition: JSON editor is a draft-admission boundary: successful Serde replacement is not semantic Recipe.validate, so invalid dimensional drafts can remain in Editor while generate fails and prior mesh remains. This can be valid editor behavior but Editor.parameters/preset/origin do not explicitly distinguish draft versus successfully rendered profile. Save writes current draft without semantic validation. Array-as-RGB and enum-string editor dispatch are broad helpers but actual closed recipe JSON uses Pigment RGB and the named topology enums; no demonstrated arbitrary-array corruption. LOD dirty-only versus preset dirty+reframe are independent work requests, not redundant booleans.
role_dispositions.remedy: Represent draft document separately from last validated/rendered recipe and its identity; decide whether Save means draft export or valid production document and preserve that distinction. Use canonical topology/preset owners for controls rather than duplicating variant vocabularies as raw strings. Retain independent rebuild/reframe requests.
role_dispositions.acceptance: Full1-151 personally consumed. Generation validation/retained old mesh are traced in1053 and prior053/054 parameter/geometry contracts. No UI/runtime execution or claim all user edits are invalid.
